name: Deconstruct IR Graph
description: Deconstruct impulse response graph structure into ImpulseResponse(s). It reads the responses of the simulation method whose component the graph came from: Simulate Mono gives the mono responses, Simulate Binaural the binaural ones, Simulate Ambisonics the ambisonic ones.

inputParameters.name: source_idx
inputParameters.description: Index(s) of the source(s) to filter, in the order of the scene's sources. With receiver_idx it picks a source-receiver combination, e.g. to pass a single impulse response to Analyse Impulse Response.

inputParameters.name: receiver_idx
inputParameters.description: Index(s) of the receiver(s) to filter.

outputParameters.name: edges
outputParameters.description: Relationships between sources and receivers as Line(s).
